notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h2]BUG FIX[/h2]

[list]

[*] Fixed a bug where the 2nd secret level couldn't be completed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lever couldn't be interacted with if a ghost was overlapping it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lever couldn't be interacted by a ghost with if the player character was overlapping it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lumberjack would switch orientation when pushed by a growing plant.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Coming Soon" level started the last level played.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lumberjack couldn't push the clock.

[/list]

[h2]FEATURE ADD[/h2]

[list]
[*] The pause menu redirects the player to the level selector instead of the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: Parallel Past is officially here! Dive into this thrilling adventure and experience its exciting gameplay. With its first 27 levels and two breathtaking biomes, the game promises hours of fun. Don’t miss the chance to explore the mysteries of Parallel Past; start your journey today!
